app.footer: Version {version} · Nothing is ever permanently deleted
app.quit_busy_text: If you quit now, the operation will be interrupted. No file will be lost: you can resume or undo it next time Rangeo starts.
common.busy_text: Another operation is already running: {task}. Wait for it to finish.
tray.still_running_text: Rangeo keeps watching your folders. Click the icon near the clock to open it again.
home.title: Hello 👋
home.subtitle: Sort your drives safely: Rangeo analyzes, you review, then it sorts. Everything can be undone.
home.drop_title: Drop a folder or a drive here
home.drop_text: Rangeo will analyze it and show you the result before touching anything.
home.action_sort_text: Photos, videos, music, documents… every file in its place.
home.action_dups_text: Free up space by finding identical files.
home.action_watch_text: Sort your downloads automatically as soon as they arrive.
home.no_recent: Nothing sorted yet. Start by dropping a folder above!
home.safety: Safety: every move is written to a journal before it happens. Copies between drives are verified before the original is removed. Deletions go to the Recycle Bin. You can undo everything from History.
sort.title: Sort
sort.subtitle: Choose what to sort and where. Rangeo will show you a full preview before changing anything.
sort.step_sources_text: Add one or more folders, or a whole drive. You can also drop them here.
sort.in_place_hint: Subfolders such as “Pictures”, “Documents”… are created directly inside the sorted folder.
sort.step_how_text: The profile contains the sorting rules. You can edit them at any time.
sort.nothing_changes: 🔒 Nothing is changed at this step: the analysis only prepares a preview.
sort.analyzing_text: Rangeo is scanning folders and reading file information (photo dates, music tags…). No file is changed.
sort.confirm_text:
{n} items ({size}) will be sorted into {dest}.

Every operation is recorded: you can undo everything from History.
sort.confirm_trash.one: ⚠ {n} item will go to the Recycle Bin (recoverable).
sort.confirm_trash.many: ⚠ {n} items will go to the Recycle Bin (recoverable).
sort.running_text: You can pause at any time. If the computer shuts down, Rangeo will resume where it left off.
preview.title: Sorting preview
preview.subtitle: Review before starting: nothing has been changed yet. Uncheck what you don't want to sort.
preview.select_hint: Click a file to see details.
preview.mismatch: ⚠ the extension does not match the content (real type: {real})
preview.left_text: These items will not be touched. Software, games, saves and projects are kept whole so nothing breaks. If a folder was protected by mistake, select it and click “Sort it anyway”.
preview.open_up_hint: First select a protected folder in the list.
preview.nothing_to_do: Everything is already sorted! There's nothing to do.
preview.scan_errors.one: {n} item could not be read (access denied or unreadable drive). It will be left in place.
preview.scan_errors.many: {n} items could not be read (access denied or unreadable drive). They will be left in place.
progress.cancel_text: What has been done is recorded: you can resume or undo it later from History. No file will be lost.
result.errors_text: These files stayed where they were: nothing is lost.
result.undo_tip: 💡 Changed your mind? Everything can be put back exactly as before from the History page, even after restarting the computer.
exec.done_text: All files are in their new place.
exec.done_errors_text: Most files were sorted. The problematic ones stayed where they were.
exec.cancelled_text: What was done is kept. You can resume or undo everything from History.
exec.device_gone_text: The operation was stopped safely. Reconnect the drive and resume it from History.
exec.disk_full_text: There is not enough space on the destination drive. Free some space and resume from History.
plan.rule_ignore: Left in place by a rule
plan.into_itself: A folder cannot be moved into itself
plan.target_is_file: A file already has the name of a folder to create
plan.target_in_moving_folder: Destination inside a folder being moved
plan.identical_trashed: Identical copy: moved to the Recycle Bin
plan.identical_to_duplicates: Identical copy: moved to the duplicates folder
plan.conflict_skipped: A file with the same name exists: skipped
plan.replaces_existing: Replaces the existing file (sent to the Recycle Bin)
plan.conflict_loser_trashed: Older / smaller version: sent to the Recycle Bin
plan.renamed_conflict: Renamed because a file with the same name exists
plan.companion_stays: Companion file staying with its main file
plan.cloud_only: Online-only file (OneDrive…): moving it out of its synced folder or copying it to another drive would download it. Check it if you want to.
plan.not_enough_space: Not enough free space on the destination drive
plan.too_big_for_fat32: File of 4 GB or more: the destination drive (FAT32) cannot hold it. Format it as exFAT or NTFS to copy it.
error.verify_failed: The copy did not match the original (original kept)
error.source_changed: The file changed during the copy (original kept)
error.not_identical: The files are no longer identical
error.source_missing: File not found (moved or deleted meanwhile)
error.target_exists: A file already exists at the destination
error.locked: File is open in another program
error.not_in_recycle_bin: Not found in the Recycle Bin (already emptied?)
error.moved_file_missing: The sorted file no longer exists
error.source_leftovers: Sorted, but files open in another program were left at the old location (identical copies, delete them later)
error.kept_missing: The kept file no longer exists: this copy was not removed
protect.system_folder: Protected system folder: Rangeo refuses to touch it
protect.system_drive: The whole system drive cannot be sorted (choose your personal folders instead)
protect.profile_root: The whole user folder cannot be sorted (choose Downloads, Desktop, Documents…)
check.no_source: Choose at least one folder to sort
check.source_inside_destination: The folder to sort is inside the destination folder
scan.root_is_code_project: “{path}” is a code project: it is kept whole. Choose a folder containing it to sort it.
scan.root_is_software: “{path}” looks like installed software or a game: it is left untouched.
scan.root_is_app_data: “{path}” contains application data: it is left untouched.
dups.title: Duplicates
dups.subtitle: Find perfectly identical files (same content, even with a different name) and free up space.
dups.where_text: Duplicates are searched in all selected folders, including across them.
dups.options_text: Rangeo first compares sizes, then the beginning and end of files, then their full content: no false duplicates possible.
dups.keep_rule: File kept automatically: {rules}. You can change this choice for each group.
dups.searching_text: Files are only read: nothing is changed.
dups.results_text: In each group, the file marked 🔒 is kept. The others will be handled with the chosen action.
dups.remove_tip: This file will be processed (check it to keep it instead)
dups.select_hint: Select a file for a preview.
dups.what_to_do: What to do with the copies?
dups.action_trash: Send them to the Recycle Bin
dups.action_move_hint: Safest: you review them and delete them yourself.
dups.action_trash_hint: Recoverable from the Windows Recycle Bin.
dups.action_hardlink_hint: Advanced: frees space without deleting anything (same drive only). Editing one file also edits the other.
dups.confirm_move: {n} copies ({size}) will be moved to the duplicates folder. You can undo from History.
dups.confirm_trash: {n} copies ({size}) will be sent to the Recycle Bin. You can undo from History.
dups.confirm_hardlink: {n} copies ({size}) will be replaced with hard links to the kept file. You can undo from History.
dups.hardlink_skipped.one: {n} copy is on another drive: it cannot become a hard link and will be skipped.
dups.hardlink_skipped.many: {n} copies are on another drive: they cannot become hard links and will be skipped.
dup.hardlink_other_disk: On another drive: hard link impossible
rules.title: Sorting rules
rules.subtitle: Rules are checked from top to bottom: the first matching rule decides where the file goes.
rules.delete_profile_text: Delete the profile “{name}” and all its rules?
rules.last_profile: At least one profile must be kept.
rules.import_failed: This file is not a valid Rangeo profile.
rules.reset_rules_text: This profile's rules will be replaced by the original rules. Continue?
rules.order_hint: Drag and drop to change the order. Uncheck to disable a rule.
rules.test_no_rule: No rule matches: the file would stay in place.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.match_any: at least one condition is true
rules.no_condition: No condition: the rule applies to every file.
rules.target: Destination folder (relative to the destination, or a full path):
rules.template_help: Variables between { } are replaced with the file's information. A part between [ ] disappears if one of its variables is empty, e.g. “{title}[ ({release_year})]”. If a variable of the new name is missing, the original name is kept.
rules.preview_ignore: Matching files will be left in place.
rules.preview_trash: Matching files will be sent to the Recycle Bin (recoverable).
rules.err_unknown_var: A variable is unknown (check the spelling).
rules.err_parent: “..” is not allowed in the path.
rules.err_regex: The regular expression is not valid.
rules.err_trash_all: Warning: with no condition, this rule would send ALL files to the Recycle Bin.
rules.err_number: A size or number is not valid (example: 500 MB).
rules.tree_text: This is the folder tree produced by this profile's rules. ✨ folders are created automatically for each file (year, artist…). Renaming a folder updates the related rules. Folders added here are created even if they stay empty.
rules.tree_dynamic: Automatic folder: its name depends on each file
rules.tree_dynamic_rename: This folder is automatic: edit the rule that uses it instead.
rules.tree_in_use: This folder is used by: {rules}. Edit or delete these rules first.
rules.profile_options_text: These settings are suggested automatically when you choose this profile.
field.name: Full name
field.title: Title
var.title: title
meta.title: Title
kind.subtitle: Subtitles
history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every operation performed. Each one can be undone, even after a restart.
history.undo_text: {n} files will be put back in their original place. Files sent to the Recycle Bin will be restored.
history.undo_done_text: {n} operations undone: everything is back in place.
history.undo_partial_text: {n} operations could not be undone (see details). The others were undone.
history.delete_text: Remove this session from history? You will no longer be able to undo it. Files are not touched.
recovery.title: An operation was interrupted
recovery.text: The sort from {date} did not finish (crash, power cut or disconnected drive). {done} operations had been done, {todo} were left. No file is lost.
watch.title: Automatic sorting
watch.subtitle: Rangeo watches the chosen folders and sorts each new file as soon as it has fully arrived.
watch.how: Files are sorted with the chosen profile, only once their download is complete. Rangeo must stay open (icon near the clock). Each sort appears in History and can be undone.
watch.folders_text: Turn each folder on or off with the switch.
watch.empty: No watched folder. Add your Downloads folder, for example.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes are saved automatically.
settings.language_text: Language of the interface and of default folder names.
settings.autostart_text: Needed for automatic sorting. Rangeo starts quietly near the clock.
settings.tray: Keep Rangeo running when the window is closed
settings.notifications_text: Tell me when a sort is finished.
settings.conflict: If a file with the same name already exists
settings.identical: If the existing file is identical
settings.identical_text: Exact same content (verified byte for byte).
settings.dates_text: For folders by year and month.
settings.dates_smart: Date taken, then date in name, then oldest (recommended)
settings.dates_exif_created: Date taken, then created, then modified
settings.detect_bundles_text: Program folders, games, saves and code projects are kept whole.
settings.companions_text: Subtitles follow their video, .xmp files follow their photo…
settings.cleanup_text: Only folders emptied by the sort.
settings.deep_check: Check the real type of every file
settings.deep_check_text: Reads the beginning of each file to detect wrong extensions (slower).
settings.fix_ext_text: E.g. a .jpg that is really a .png is renamed to .png.
settings.priority_text: “Quiet” slows Rangeo down so it does not disturb your work.
settings.dup_min_text: Very small files are often technical files.
settings.dup_keep: File to keep (check and order the criteria, drag and drop):
settings.dup_preferred: Preferred folders (the file located there is kept)
settings.exclusions_text: Folder or file names (wildcards * and ? allowed) or full paths that Rangeo never scans.
settings.keep_whole_text: These folders stay whole (e.g. an already organized photo album). Tip: an empty file named “.rangeo-keep” inside a folder does the same.
settings.protected_text: On top of system folders (always protected), Rangeo will never touch these folders.
settings.data_text: Back up or transfer your settings and rules.
settings.import_failed: This file is not a valid Rangeo configuration.
settings.clear_cache_text: The cache avoids reading already analyzed files again. Clearing it will slow down the next analysis. Continue?
settings.apply_later: An operation is in progress: the change will apply once it is finished (change the setting again afterwards).
settings.about: Rangeo {version} — disk sorting software for Windows. Your data never leaves your computer.
conflict.overwrite: Replace (old one goes to the Recycle Bin)
conflict.keep_newest: Keep the newest (other to the Recycle Bin)
conflict.keep_largest: Keep the largest (other to the Recycle Bin)
identical.duplicates: Put the copy in the duplicates folder
identical.trash: Send the copy to the Recycle Bin
report.title: Rangeo report
wizard.welcome_text: A few settings and you're ready to sort your drives.
wizard.safe_preview_text: Rangeo analyzes and shows you exactly where each file will go. Nothing moves without your approval.
wizard.safe_verify_text: Between drives, each copy is read back and compared with the original before the original is removed.
wizard.safe_undo_text: Every operation is recorded in a journal. One click puts everything back, even after a crash.
wizard.safe_protect_text: Windows, installed programs, games and projects are never scattered.
wizard.safe_trash_text: Anything to delete goes to the Recycle Bin (or a “Rangeo - Corbeille” folder on USB drives).
wizard.watch_text: Rangeo can sort your new downloads as soon as they arrive. You can change this at any time.
scan.root_is_rom_collection: “{path}” is an emulator game collection: it is left untouched.
media.error: This file cannot be played here (unsupported format or damaged file).
dups.mode_exact_hint: Same content byte for byte, even with a different name. No risk of error.
dups.mode_images_hint: Finds the same photo resized, recompressed, converted (JPG/PNG/HEIC) or slightly edited.
dups.mode_music_hint: Recognizes the same song in different formats or bitrates (MP3, FLAC, AAC…) using an audio fingerprint.
dups.mode_videos_hint: Compares frames: finds the same video in another resolution or quality.
dups.similar_warning: These files look alike but are not strictly identical: check the groups before applying. By default, the best quality is kept.
rename.title: Bulk rename
rename.subtitle: Clean up and standardize your file names. The preview updates live; everything can be undone.
rename.template_help: If some information is missing for a file (no date taken, no GPS…), it keeps its current name.
rename.empty: Add a folder to see the preview.
rename.n_failed.one: {n} file could not be renamed (see History).
rename.n_failed.many: {n} files could not be renamed (see History).
rename.confirm_text: {n} files will be renamed. You can undo from History.
analysis.title: Drive analysis
analysis.subtitle: Where does the space go? What can be cleaned? The analysis changes nothing.
analysis.intro: Choose a drive or a folder and click “Analyze”: you will see a map of the space used, the biggest files, temporary files, empty folders, old installers… Every cleanup goes through the Recycle Bin and can be undone.
analysis.big_hint: The 500 biggest files. Double-click to show them in Explorer.
analysis.old_hint: Files over 1 MB not modified for {n} years.
analysis.temp_hint: Temporary files, thumbnail caches, Mac files, abandoned downloads… They can be removed safely (they go to the Recycle Bin).
analysis.empty_hint: Folders that contain no file (not even in their subfolders).
analysis.installers_hint: Old installer versions: the newest version of each program is kept.
analysis.corrupt_hint: Checks that the photos, videos, music, PDFs and archives of this folder can be read (may take a while).
analysis.confirm_trash: {n} files ({size}) will be sent to the Recycle Bin. You can undo from History.
analysis.confirm_dirs: {n} empty folders will be removed. You can undo from History.
analysis.history_text: Data sorted per month and space freed (duplicates, cleanup).
auto.title: Automation
auto.subtitle: Let Rangeo sort on its own: when files arrive, at a fixed time, or when you plug in a drive.
schedule.title: Scheduled sorts
schedule.subtitle: They work even when Rangeo is closed (Windows Task Scheduler).
schedule.how: A scheduled sort runs without a preview: the chosen profile's rules apply directly. Each run appears in History and can be undone. If the computer was off at the planned time, the sort runs at the next start.
schedule.name: Name:
schedule.warning: Check your rules with a manual sort before scheduling.
schedule.desc_monthly: On day {day} of each month at {time}
schedule.result_invalid: not possible: check the folders and the destination
schedule.result_no_space: not possible: not enough space at the destination
schedule.install_failed: Windows did not accept the scheduled task.
devices.how: When you plug in a USB stick, an SD card or an external drive, Rangeo can offer to sort it, or do it automatically (e.g. sort the DCIM folder of a camera card into your Pictures). Rangeo must be running (icon near the clock).
devices.ask_unknown: Offer to sort newly plugged drives
devices.title: Known drives
devices.subtitle: Each drive is recognized by its serial number, even if its letter changes.
devices.none: No external drive plugged in right now.
devices.notify_unknown: Click here to sort its content with Rangeo.
devices.notify_busy: An operation is already running: click here to sort it later.
devices.notify_done: {n} files sorted from {name}. Click to view.
settings.context_menu_text: In Explorer, right-click a folder or a drive (on Windows 11: “Show more options”).
winmenu.label: Sort with Rangeo
install.install_text: Rangeo will be copied to {path}, with a shortcut in the Start menu and on the Desktop, and will appear in “Add or remove programs”.
install.done_text: Rangeo will restart from its new location.
install.uninstall_text: The program, its shortcuts, the right-click menu and the scheduled sorts will be removed. Your files are never touched.
install.remove_data: Also delete my settings, rules and history
install.dev_mode: “Source code” version: installation is available from Rangeo.exe.
home.install_banner: Rangeo is not installed yet: install it to have it in the Start menu and to be able to uninstall it cleanly.
history.in_use: This session is still running in a scheduled sort in the background. Try again once it has finished.
